The '''Hapes system''', also referred to as the '''Hapan system''',<ref name="LotF">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was home to [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] as well as the planet [[Kavan]], where [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] was killed. It was located within the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].
